title: Pact of the Eternal Sky
premise: On the wind-scoured steppes of Khergai, nomadic clans bind their fates to ancient sky spirits. As the spirits begin to vanish, a disgraced shaman's apprentice, a war-host's exiled heir, and a spirit seeking a mortal name must journey to the Sky-Grave to discover who is severing the pacts.
constraints: Locations should feel vast and wind-bitten.
